description: Validate that users can navigate between the RoostGPT tabs seamlessly.
steps: Navigate to the Test Suites page.
Verify that the Analysis page is displayed.
Ensure that the Generations page is loaded.
Return to the Test Suites tab.
Verify that the Test Suites page is displayed again.
expected_results: Users can navigate seamlessly between tabs.
Each tab displays its respective content correctly.
The browser URL updates to reflect the selected tab.
edge_cases: Navigate to a tab during high traffic.
Validate navigation with browser caching disabled.
Verify behavior when tabs are clicked rapidly.
Ensure tab navigation works on mobile devices.
Test navigation with slow network conditions.
data_requirements: Test data to verify correct rendering.
Network conditions to simulate edge cases.
dependencies: Tabs are correctly linked to their respective pages.
Backend APIs provide content for each tab.
User permissions allow access to all tabs.
performance_metrics: Tab navigation should complete within 1 second.
Content loading should not block other interactions.
accessibility_requirements: Tabs should have ARIA roles and labels.
Ensure tabs are navigable via keyboard.
